title: Public read-only RAG demo HTTP contract

GET /api/demo.description: Existing corpus metadata plus public mode information; suggested_questions are the only permitted input questions.

POST /api/demo/chat.description: Only available in public mode. Reject browser credentials and non-featured questions; server fixes scope and request identities. Successful response requires actual in-scope retrieval hits.

GET /api/trace/{trace_id}.description: Existing SpanEvent array for this isolated public process only; no synthetic spans or private-service data.

ChatRequest.description: question must exactly equal an item in GET /api/demo suggested_questions; allowlist is checked at runtime.
